events.title: Jennifer Lopez turns 57
events.blurb: Global superstar Jennifer Lopez celebrates her 57th birthday today.

angles.name: J-Lo's enduring appeal
angles.copy: From the Bronx to global icon, Jennifer Lopez is 57 today! What's your favourite J-Lo track that still gets you on the dancefloor?

events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary frontman of The Rolling Stones, Mick Jagger, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll icon
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still moving like Jagger! Happy Birthday to the one and only Mick Jagger.

events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: Music Television, MTV, launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its first broadcast.

angles.name: The day music TV changed everything
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, MTV launched and changed how we saw music forever. What was the first music video that blew your mind?

events.title: Woodstock Festival 57th anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, '3 Days of Peace & Music', began on August 15, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the legendary Woodstock Festival kicked off! Imagine being there for '3 Days of Peace & Music'.

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's death
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42. He would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering The King. It's 49 years since the world lost Elvis Presley. His music lives on forever.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis track or solo anthem?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated globally as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend and peace activist, John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His message of peace and music resonates more than ever.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy legend's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment from a true comedy legend?
